description: Given two lists of integers a and b, return a list of the values that occur in exactly one of them (in a but not in b, or in b but not in a), sorted in non-decreasing order. Every value of a that does not occur in b and every value of b that does not occur in a must appear in the result, and no value that occurs in both lists (or in neither) may appear. Each such value should be listed once. Either input may be empty.
notes: VERINA's description asks for a result without duplicates, but its Lean postcondition only requires the result to be sorted in non-decreasing order (Pairwise <=) together with the membership conditions. Both specs follow the Lean postcondition, so a result with repeated values would satisfy the spec; the tests (VERINA's expected outputs) contain each value once.
